entities.name: Query RlmN protein
observations: 348 aa basic soluble protein; predicted molecular weight 39.2 kDa and pI 8.90.
Pfam matches RlmN_N at residues 10–60 and Radical_SAM at residues 107–273.
Homologs A3DCX9, A8MH89, and A0Q112 show 54.5–56.3% identity over 91.4–97.4% of the sequence.
Most likely a dual-specificity radical-SAM RNA methyltransferase, but exact dual substrate activity is inferred from homologs rather than directly experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: RlmN
observations: Curated homolog annotations assign methylation of adenine 2503 in 23S rRNA and adenine 37 in tRNA.
Binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and an exchangeable S-adenosyl-L-methionine.
Radical-SAM catalysis uses SAM cleavage to generate 5'-deoxyadenosyl radical chemistry; an S-methylcysteine intermediate is annotated in homologs.
Cytoplasmic enzyme involved in rRNA and tRNA base methylation.

entities.name: RlmN rRNA A2503 methylation
observations: Adenosine(2503) in 23S rRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine(2503), using two SAM molecules and reduced electron donors; products include 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, and S-adenosylhomocysteine in the mapped Rhea representation.
Rhea mappings include RHEA:42916 and associated radical-SAM component reactions.

entities.name: RlmN tRNA A37 methylation
observations: Adenosine(37) in tRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine(37), using two SAM molecules and reduced electron donors; products include 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, and S-adenosylhomocysteine in the mapped Rhea representation.
Rhea mappings include RHEA:43332 and associated radical-SAM component reactions.
